verses.1: Praise ye the LORD. Blessed is the man that feareth the LORD, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.
verses.2: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
verses.3: Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
verses.4: To the upright there ariseth light in darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.
verses.5: A good man showeth favor, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.
verses.6: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.
verses.7: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.
verses.8: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he seeth his desire upon his enemies.
verses.9: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honor.
verses.10: The wicked shall see it , and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.

metadata.source: Derived from Webster's Bible (1833), simplified for children aged 8-12. Faithful to the KJV tradition.
